title: USC Transportation FAQ (Parking and Transit)
text:
WARNING: most FAQ entries on this page are undated, and the two dated entries are from 2013-2014. Prices and procedures may be outdated. Check the current USC Transportation announcements before relying on them.

TRANSIT PASSES
- A Student Metro TAP card can be loaded by USC Transportation, but the student must first apply for the Student TAP pass with Metro (FAQ posted January 31, 2014).
- Metro Annual or 30-day pass: $100/month (undated). Monthly LADOT (Commuter Express/DASH) and Metrolink passes vary by zone. DASH coupon books: $30 (undated).
- Ride-sharing options listed: Metro Bus and Rail, Metrolink Train, carpools and DASH bus lines.
- Faculty and staff can sign up for an Annual or 30-day Metro TAP pass deducted from their paycheck; applications are due by the 10th of the month for the 1st of the next month.

PARKING PERMITS
- Permits can be paid by cash (over the counter), check, university feebill or payroll deduction (posted December 4, 2013).
- Permits are sold online during the year. They cannot be bought by phone.
- Permits cannot be shared. Permits taped to a windshield or hung on an unauthorized hanger can lead to vehicle immobilization and a large fine.
- Two- or three-day temporary passes are sold at gate entrances. Temporary passes longer than three days are sold only at the Transportation Services office.
- Reserved spaces are only for USC faculty and staff and require a departmental or Director's recommendation. To buy a Reserved permit or join a waitlist, email auxtrans@usc.edu.
- A reserved space cannot be transferred to another person if its lot or structure has a waiting list.

CONTACT
- USC Transportation, 620 McCarthy Way (McCarthy Structure), Los Angeles, CA 90089.
- Phone: (213) 740-3575. Email: auxtrans@usc.edu.

NOT COVERED ON THIS PAGE
- Current student parking permit timing per semester, renewal and lottery rules.
- Shuttle or bus routes and schedules (links only).
- U-Pass details and any 'Trojan Transit' information.
